# Crown Tourist Home

> Clean, comfortable, and affordable budget lodging located on Chalakudy–Anamala Road in Pariyaram, Kerala, right beside the Chalakudy River and 20 minutes from Athirappilly Waterfalls.

Crown Tourist Home provides honest, spotless accommodation for families, couples, and travelers along the Athirappilly scenic corridor. All rooms feature private attached washrooms with 24/7 running water, fresh laundered linens and towels for every guest, high-speed Wi-Fi, and secure on-site parking.

## Key Information
- **Location**: Poovathingal, Chalakudy - Anamala Road, Pariyaram, Kerala 680721, India
- **Phone / Reception**: [+91 62827 08488](tel:+916282708488)
- **WhatsApp Booking**: [+91 81296 46522](https://wa.me/918129646522)
- **Check-in / Check-out**: Standard 12:00 PM (Flexible check-in available upon coordination with reception)
- **Payment Methods**: Google Pay (UPI), Cash

## Room Types & Tariffs

- [Standard Room (Non-AC)](https://crowntouristhome.com/#rooms): ₹900 – ₹1,000 / night. Single, 2 singles, or double bed options, high-speed ceiling fan, 1 table & 2 chairs, attached private clean washroom, free Wi-Fi. Extra mattress available for ₹200.
- [Deluxe AC Double Room](https://crowntouristhome.com/#rooms): ₹1,300 / night. Comfortable foam double mattress, powerful split air conditioning, wall-mounted TV with cable channels, desk, table & 2 chairs, attached clean bathroom, free Wi-Fi. Extra mattress available for ₹200.
- [Spacious Triple AC Room](https://crowntouristhome.com/#rooms): ₹1,500 – ₹1,600 / night. Sleeps 3 to 4 persons, 2 twin beds, split air conditioning, TV, table & 2 chairs for work or dining, spacious attached private bathroom, free Wi-Fi. Extra mattress available for ₹200.

## Property Facilities

- Clean bed sheets, pillow covers, and fresh bath towels changed for every guest check-in
- Attached private tiled washrooms with continuous 24/7 running water
- Free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the premises
- 24/7 CCTV surveillance and covered front vehicle parking
- Ground-floor highway roadside access on Chalakudy–Anamala Road
- Walking distance (50 m) to the Chalakudy River for peaceful waterside strolls

## Nearby Attractions & Sightseeing

- [Chalakudy River](https://crowntouristhome.com/#attractions): Directly beside the property (50 m / 1 min walk). Scenic river views and breezes.
- [CSR Check Dam (Kombanpara)](https://crowntouristhome.com/#attractions): 1.2 km (3 min drive / 15 min walk). Scenic river weir and cascading ripples. 4.5 ★ on Google (408+ reviews).
- [Dream World Water Theme Park](https://crowntouristhome.com/#attractions): 3.5 km (5 min drive). Family amusement park with wave pool and slides.
- [Silver Storm Water Theme Park & Snow Storm](https://crowntouristhome.com/#attractions): 7 km (10 min drive). Thrill rides and sub-zero snow dome.
- [Thumboormuzhi Dam & Hanging Bridge](https://crowntouristhome.com/#attractions): 8.5 km (12 min drive). Suspension footbridge and butterfly garden.
- [Athirappilly Waterfalls](https://crowntouristhome.com/#attractions): 17 km (25 min drive). Kerala's largest 80-foot waterfall ("Niagara of India").
- [Charpa & Vazhachal Waterfalls](https://crowntouristhome.com/#attractions): 21–25 km (32 min drive). Pristine forest rapids and roadside falls.

## Dining Nearby

- [Vasuvettante Kada](https://crowntouristhome.com/#dining): Famous 4.5 ★ Kerala highway restaurant (5 min drive), renowned for hot banana leaf noon meals, nadan beef fry, prawns paal curry, and river fish fry.
- Local tea stalls (chaya kadas) and bakeries: 100 m – 200 m (1-2 min walk) for fresh breakfast, tea, and snacks.
